# Macrion 0.1.0

This is the first public Macrion release. Macrion is based on Klick'r, and all existing features from Klick'r 4.0.1 remain available alongside the additions below.

## What's new in Macrion

- **Scenario Switcher:** Quickly move between Smart scenarios from the floating toolbar. Switching is designed around the paused state so you can change the loaded scenario without setting everything up again.
- **Tasker, MacroDroid, and Automate integration:** Use their Tasker-compatible plugin support to launch a selected scenario, stop Macrion, run the currently paused scenario, query live scenario status, and react to External Actions fired by a Smart scenario.
- **Enhanced Debug Reports:** Inspect event activity and condition performance, including total and average check times. The timeline also offers better navigation and filtering, detection/action timing, and visibility into Execution Limiter idle time.

## Built on Klick'r 4.0.1

Macrion is derived from [Klick'r / Smart AutoClicker](https://github.com/Nain57/Smart-AutoClicker). The image-detection automations, regular clicking mode, actions, conditions, triggers, tutorials, and other capabilities available in Klick'r 4.0.1 are present here as well.

Macrion is still an early release. Back up important scenarios before upgrading and report problems through the repository's issue tracker.

## Installation

Download the APK matching your device. `arm64-v8a` is the usual choice for modern Android phones; use the universal APK if you are unsure.

Because Macrion is distributed directly through GitHub, Android may ask you to allow installation from your browser or file manager. The app also needs Accessibility and screen-capture access for its core automation features.
